description: Access Pass QA chain for one use case: test plan -> human scripts -> pytest scaffolds -> review. Run with the specs repo as project_dir, e.g. init_run.sh "$HOME/dev/QA auto/specs" uc-01-qa --template qa-access-pass --var UC=UC-01 --var QA_AUTOMATION="$HOME/dev/QA auto/qa-automation"

tasks.title: QA test plan for {{UC}}
done_criteria: One plan file for {{UC}} under qa/test-plans/
Every case is anchored to a spec section
Out-of-scope items (rate limits, External UCs) are stated, not tested
tasks.brief:
# Task plan: QA test plan for {{UC}}

## Goal
Use the `qa-test-planner` skill to write the QA test plan for {{UC}}.

## Inputs the skill would otherwise ask for
- Spec repo (local path): {{PROJECT}}
- Target use case: {{UC}}
- Jira ticket: <APAS20-xxx or none>

## Files
- **May write: qa/test-plans/ only.**

## Done when
- [ ] qa/test-plans/{{UC}}-*.md exists and follows the skill's format
- [ ] Every case cites its spec anchor

## Verify with
`ls qa/test-plans/{{UC}}-*.md` and re-read the file against the skill's checklist

tasks.title: Human test scripts for {{UC}}
done_criteria: One scripts file for {{UC}} under qa/scripts/
Every plan case has executable steps
Missing fixtures are flagged as gaps, not invented
tasks.brief:
# Task scripts: Human test scripts for {{UC}}

## Goal
Use the `qa-script-writer` skill to turn the plan from the previous task into human-executable scripts.

## Inputs the skill would otherwise ask for
- Spec repo (local path): {{PROJECT}}
- Target plan: qa/test-plans/{{UC}}-*.md

## Files
- **May write: qa/scripts/ only.**

## Verify with
`ls qa/scripts/{{UC}}-*-scripts.md`, and check every plan case id appears in the scripts

tasks.title: Pytest scaffolds for {{UC}}
done_criteria: Module headers pin the script-commit SHA
tasks.brief:
# Task pytest: Pytest scaffolds for {{UC}}

## Goal
Use the `qa-script-to-pytest` skill to scaffold pytest modules from the scripts written by the previous task.

## Inputs the skill would otherwise ask for
- Spec repo (local path): {{PROJECT}}
- QA automation repo (local path): {{QA_AUTOMATION}}
- Target script: qa/scripts/{{UC}}-*-scripts.md

## Files
- **May write: {{QA_AUTOMATION}}/tests/e2e_tests/ only.**

## Verify with
`cd "{{QA_AUTOMATION}}" && python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q tests/e2e_tests/`

tasks.title: Review the {{UC}} QA chain
done_criteria: Traceability checked plan -> scripts -> pytest; gaps listed with file:line
tasks.accept: <command that verifies review findings against the specification and integration tests>
tasks.brief:
# Task review: Review the {{UC}} QA chain

## Goal
Check that every case in the plan has script steps and a pytest scaffold (or a stated reason not to), that every case is spec-anchored, and that nothing out of scope was added. Do not edit files.

## Files
- **May write: nothing except your report.**

## Verify with
Read qa/test-plans/{{UC}}-*.md, qa/scripts/{{UC}}-*-scripts.md and {{QA_AUTOMATION}}/tests/e2e_tests/
